english.title: Fail to report theft of regulated / reportable substance
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person carrying on a business, trade or profession that involved

(A)_[regulated]_
(B)_[reportable]_
(C)_[regulated and reportable]_

substances, failed to report the significant disappearance or theft of substances from stock in your possession, custody or control in Great Britain
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3C(5) and 8(4) of the Poisons Act 1972.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) A duty under this section 'to report' something is a duty to give notice of it to the Secretary of State in accordance with such requirements as may be specified by the Secretary of State by regulations made under this subsection.
(ii) As provided in section 3C(6) in deciding whether a disappearance or theft is significant, regard must be had to whether the amount involved is unusual in all the circumstances of the case.
(iii) A person does not commit an offence under this section if the requirements do not apply to the person's case by virtue of regulations made under section 9B.
